nodes.Name: SortImports
nodes.DocComment:
SortImports sorts runs of consecutive import lines in import blocks in f.
It also removes duplicate imports when it is possible to do so without data loss.

nodes.Name: collapse
nodes.DocComment: collapse indicates whether prev may be removed, leaving only next.

Fields.Name: left
Fields.DocComment: true if comment is to the left of the spec, false otherwise.

Else.Name: if
Else.RawSource: specIndex+1 < len(specs) && lineAt(fset, pos[specIndex].Start)+1 == lineAt(fset, g.Pos())

nodes.Name: updateBasicLitPos
nodes.DocComment:
updateBasicLitPos updates lit.Pos,
ensuring that lit.End is displaced by the same amount.
(See https://go.dev/issue/76395.)
